entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A high-fantasy medieval plane of knights, castles and fairy tales, where five knightly courts oppose the magical creatures of the Wilds.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Garruk, kidnaps the High King of Eldraine.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps Oko kidnap the High King and is later freed from his curse.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The High King of Eldraine, kidnapped by Oko and Garruk and later saved.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: One of the High King's twin children, who embarks on a quest to save him and whose spark ignites.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: One of the High King's twin children, who embarks on a quest to save him and whose spark ignites.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: The region of Eldraine inhabited by magical creatures, opposed to the five knightly courts.

entities.name: Five knightly courts
entities.description: The five knightly courts of Eldraine's Realm: Ardenvale, Vantress, Locthwain, Embereth and Garenbrig.

events.summary: The planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith, disrupting Eldraine's status quo.
events.quote: The status quo is disrupted when the planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith .

events.summary: The twins Rowan and Will Kenrith embark on a quest to save their father.
events.quote: embark on a quest to save their father

events.summary: The king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' spark ignites.
events.quote: In the end, the king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' Planeswalker's spark ignites .

relations.note: Rowan is the High King's daughter.
relations.quote: His children, the twins Rowan and Will Kenrith

relations.note: Will is the High King's son.
